name: Orondo Grade TC

origin.basis: Rene Herse Cycles sells its tires from its own US web store in US dollars.

manufacturing.basis: Rene Herse product pages state the tires are made in Japan.

weight_basis: Rene Herse weight for the Standard casing; other casings in the size note.

availability.note: Sold by Rene Herse's US web store; other regions not verified.

positioning: Rene Herse's tubeless 31 mm road tire in Standard, Extralight and Endurance casings.
hookless_note: Rene Herse says it suits hookless or hooked rims with 15-25 mm inner width, up to 90 psi.
caveats: Older narrow non-tubeless rims can make mounting very difficult.

price_observations.conditions: Official store range US$89-99 by casing on 2026-11-01; the lowest price is shown; one tire.

image.shown: 700C x 31 TC tan-wall Orondo Grade as pictured on Rene Herse's product page.
image.alt: Rene Herse Orondo Grade 700C x 31 TC tire with tan sidewalls and printed size
